literal_meaning: fried and roasted (various kinds of fried and stir-fried food items)
figurative_meaning_en: various kinds of fried and roasted delicious food items
example_sentences_in_bangla: রোজ ভাজাভুজি খেলে শরীর খারাপ হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Eating fried and roasted foods every day will harm your health.
Fried and roasted delicacies have been arranged for the party.
note: Refers to rich, oily Bengali street or home-cooked foods, often implying excess consumption.
